title: Bus control messages
description: Params and results of the bus.* messages. bus.init: request, params InitParams, result InitResult. bus.ready, bus.start, bus.pause, bus.resume: notifications, params Empty. bus.ack: notification, params AckParams. bus.shutdown: request, params and result Empty.

InitResult.description: rbtcd's answer to bus.init when the registry is valid and it is this daemon's turn to initialise.

datadir.description: The daemon's own data directory, already created. The daemon must not write outside it.

config.description: The daemon's section of the config file as a JSON object, unvalidated. The daemon applies defaults and rejects unknown keys and invalid values.

AckParams.description: bus.ack params: the next count notifications are handled; rbtcd returns their credit.
